test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

There are already many examples of great technology that had born in the United States.
solution:
The correct answer is "**of great technology that had**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The given sentence is in present tense as indicated by the use of the word "are."**
 
• **Thus, the use of the verb "had" is incorrect.**
 
• The correct verb form to use in this sentence is "has" instead of "had" as the technology still exists.
 
• Also, has will be the perfect verb since, the subject "great technology" is singular.
 
• The correct sentence should be:
 
 
• "There are already many examples of great technology that has been born in the United States."
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3.**
